quality_scoring_model.formula: Q(c) = w_richness * S_richness + w_usefulness * S_usefulness + w_confidence * S_confidence + w_uniqueness * S_uniqueness

semantic_richness.description: Measures syntactic and semantic density of the memory assertion.

memory_usefulness.description: Evaluates practical actionability for code generation and agent planning.

verification_confidence.description: Verification snippet specificity and AST grounding strength.

uniqueness.description: Inverse symbol frequency penalty to ensure diverse module and symbol representation.

fifty_percent_single_type_cap.timing_invariant: The 50% single claim-type cap MUST strictly be evaluated and enforced BEFORE target validity gold adjudication. It is applied exclusively to frozen base-state memory claims without any knowledge or consideration of target-state validity, staleness, or ground truth.

trivial_existence_cap.rule: SYMBOL_EXISTS and CALLABLE combined must not exceed 40.0% of the benchmark.

multi_type_transition_invariant.rule: Whenever available in the verified candidate pool, each transition must sample across at least 2 distinct claim types.

repository_balance.uniformity_rule: Exactly 6 claims per repository across all 25 repositories (25 * 6 = 150 claims total).

transition_balance.uniformity_rule: Exactly 3 claims per transition across all 50 transitions (50 * 3 = 150 claims total).

category_distribution.distribution_rule: Stratified natural representation across all 6 functional categories.

human_audit_sampling_specification.sampling_method: Deterministic stratified PRNG sampling (seed=3407) ensuring representation of all 25 repositories.
human_audit_sampling_specification.purpose: Independent inter-annotator agreement and ground truth factuality audit.
